LESSON: NUMBER NUMBERS

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.7: Number NUMBERS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Number NUMBERS. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how to join these?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. rearrange number cards 1-20 in the 10 lessons
2. identify different parts of numerals 1-20 using not more than ten parts
3. join different parts of numbers to form complete number symbols 1- 20 with not more than 10 parts
4. enjoy completing number puzzles in daily life e) relate number symbols with the objects in the environment f) use ICT to complete number puzzles complete the number puzzle with the objects in the environment hopscotch. puzzles using ICT devices

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. rearrange number cards 1-20 in the 10 lessons
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to rearrange number cards 1-20 in the 10 lessons. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. identify different parts of numerals 1-20 using not more than ten parts
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify different parts of numerals 1-20 using not more than ten parts. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. join different parts of numbers to form complete number symbols 1- 20 with not more than 10 parts
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to join different parts of numbers to form complete number symbols 1- 20 with not more than 10 parts. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. enjoy completing number puzzles in daily life e) relate number symbols with the objects in the environment f) use ICT to complete number puzzles complete the number puzzle with the objects in the environment hopscotch. puzzles using ICT devices
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to enjoy completing number puzzles in daily life e) relate number symbols with the objects in the environment f) use ICT to complete number puzzles complete the number puzzle with the objects in the environment hopscotch. puzzles using ICT devices. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Number NUMBERS.
2. Explain Number NUMBERS to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Number NUMBERS.
4. Show that you can: rearrange number cards 1-20 in the 10 lessons
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Number NUMBERS. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how to join these?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. rearrange number cards 1-20 in the 10 lessons
2. identify different parts of numerals 1-20 using not more than ten parts
3. join different parts of numbers to form complete number symbols 1- 20 with not more than 10 parts
4. enjoy completing number puzzles in daily life e) relate number symbols with the objects in the environment f) use ICT to complete number puzzles complete the number puzzle with the objects in the environment hopscotch. puzzles using ICT devices

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
